generation.scope: The signed double cover modulo simultaneous S3 is the normalization of the full projective Walsh image. Its regular locus is exactly rank(N)=2. The three spectra of a balanced representative recover a finite list of normalization points even at eigenvalue collisions and zero diagonals. Comparison of orbit-closure linear spans separates all candidates, decides the period and recognizes Walsh membership for an arbitrary input tensor.

open_mathematics: Determine the global incidence and branching of the nine- and five-dimensional half-period components, identify stabilizers and construct deformation charts outside Walsh symmetry. Unrestricted AS membership and global coverage remain open.
